name: Diverse Music Recommendations
description: Users want a more extensive music library with less repetitive recommendations to discover new music. The current algorithm fails to offer fresh and relevant music, leading to frustration.

name: Intuitive Discovery UI
description: Users need a simplified and intuitive user interface for music discovery to reduce cognitive load and confusion. The current design is overwhelming and cluttered, making it hard to find new music.

name: Social Music Sharing
description: Users want an in-app social layer for music discovery and sharing to connect with friends and like-minded individuals. This feature would enhance the overall music experience and encourage social interaction.

name: Personalized Playlists
description: Users desire personalized playlists that cater to their mood, activity, or preferences to improve their listening experience. The lack of such features leads to dissatisfaction and frustration.

name: Transparent Recommendation Logic
description: Users want to understand the reasoning behind music recommendations to trust the algorithm and discover new music. The current lack of transparency leads to skepticism and frustration.
